notes.title: More Alice 3 info
notes.content:
Dear Insane Children

It's been a month since we whetted your appetite with news of us putting together a proposal to obtain the rights to take Alice off on a 3rd adventure, and we just wanted to stop by and let you all know this is still progressing.

Especially in the realm of art.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952862/036071720f2983988594fda00d68cc227ec0a0f5.jpg[/img]

You'll be happy to know that we have Joey and Sonny (previous Alice artists) back on board and we are also very happy to be working with the incredible Omri Koresh

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952862/be74cd427bc027c3a08afdd56c17d417be955773.jpg[/img]

But as with any type of independant development, we need YOUR help.

Spread the news of Alice Asylum far and wide.
Pay particular attention to this handy list of 4 things you can do to help over at...
www.americanmcgee.com

Also, if you're feeling particularly awesome, why not check out our Patreon, that was recently re-jiggled to make it even more of a bargain at the various tiers.
www.patreon.com/americanmcgee

Thank you all for your continued support of Alice and we hope to see you all along for the Asylum ride in the coming months  :)

- Cheers

notes.title: Alice 3, coming...... soon?
notes.content:
Dear Insane Children.

Did you know that we are currently putting together a proposal to licence Alice from EA and to independently create a 3rd Alice game?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952862/9f230b63e6035a938913ad4d0a5c374a189d25da.jpg[/img]

Well now you know   :)

Tentatively titled Alice Asylum, this will take place before the events of American McGee's Alice and before Wonderland is fully corrupted.

But WE NEED YOUR HELP!!!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952862/85b8c704db2d104d8e2fa4bd44b0bc019fa9dc4c.jpg[/img]

There are lots of ways you could help to make Alice 3 a reality.

1) Go to www.americanmcgee.com and you will see a handy list of 4 things to do, from supporting our Patreon to simply signing up to our Alice 3 mailing list.

2) Spread the word via your social media channels to everyone you think might be interested.  Share this post, share the pictures, tell the world, shout it from the rooftops.

3) If you're a Cosplayer, we're also currently showcasing all the great Alices out there on all our channels too, so why not send in your pics to the inbox on our Facebook page?  @alice3asylum

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952862/aaeb206acee28fb5037c033f912b86c8629638b3.jpg[/img]

So there you have it.
Exciting news I'm sure you'll agree.

For one more trip down the rabbit hole, we need the support of all you amazing fans, and we hope to see all of you on this fantastic journey.

- Thank you
